description:
Use this when you need a deterministic South Korea South Korea statutory public holidays and public-office substitute holidays for 2026 result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the package covers the 2026 statutory/public-office schedule only; private-employer, school, bank, exchange, local-government and 2027 schedules are not inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: South Korea: New Labor Day public holiday. | South Korea: Published substitute holiday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-05-01"} | {"date":"2026-10-05"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/south-korea-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/south-korea-public-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in South Korea coverage.

name: check_kr_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: South Korea statutory public holidays and public-office substitute holidays for 2026

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: National, substitute and election holiday event kinds are preserved; this is not a universal private-employer or school closure calendar.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: Only the published 2026 substitute dates are included; employer exchanges, local-government holidays and school schedules are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: South Korea Working Day
